name: IHO-IOC GEBCO Gazetteer of Undersea Feature Names

producer.name: GEBCO Sub-Committee on Undersea Feature Names (SCUFN), hosted by IHO DCDB at NOAA NCEI

rights.license: No public-domain grant found. The gazetteer page asks for this citation when names are reproduced: IHO-IOC GEBCO Gazetteer of Undersea Feature Names, www.gebco.net. The GEBCO Grid public-domain terms do not name this gazetteer. The feature-service copyrightText field was not re-read this pass, so no copyright sentence is claimed. Commercial redistribution of the name database is not expressly granted.

temporal.update_cadence: NCEI describes an annual gazetteer update after SCUFN decisions. No release instant was read from the service.

evidence.supports: Citation required when gazetteer data are used or reproduced. Host is IHO DCDB at NCEI. No public-domain sentence on this page.
Service metadata retrieved 2026-10-20. Capabilities are Query and Extract. copyrightText wording was not re-read this pass. Layers are point, line and polygon. No feature rows were downloaded.

limitations: Names may be shown as labels only with the citation IHO-IOC GEBCO Gazetteer of Undersea Feature Names, www.gebco.net.
This is not the grid public-domain grant. Display waits for N-13.
A gazetteer point is a published position, not the extent of the feature and not a surveyed name.
Do not draw a gazetteer name inside a reviewed-survey extent when it conflicts with a surveyed name.
SCUFN international naming concern is mainly outside the territorial sea. A name inside 12 nautical miles is not, by itself, an international name.
No in-box feature count was taken. Coverage of the 15 region bounds is inferred from the global service extent, not from a downloaded extract.

transformations: Read the GEBCO gazetteer page and the ArcGIS feature-service metadata on 2026-10-20. Did not download feature rows.
